title: The divers
style: cinematic horror film still, vast frozen northern lake under a pale winter sky, lonely ice fishing shacks, black open water, cold steel-blue and white tones with warm lantern amber, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. In 1974, two divers went into the circle. One came back. He never spoke again. 🤿

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: fishing lines came back from the circle cut clean, and Wade's lost hook returned, baited with his own hair.
scenes.image: small fishing hook floating in a dark hole in the ice, lantern glow

scenes.narration: Wade drives to the county library. In the basement, there's a cabinet of old sheriff's reports. Kettle Lake has its own drawer.
scenes.image: man in a parka pulling open a metal filing cabinet drawer in a dim library basement, single hanging bulb

scenes.narration: 1974. The state sent two divers to explore the circle. Gil Tanner and Ross Avery. Dry suits, lights, and a hundred feet of rope each.
scenes.image: faded 1970s photograph of two divers in old dry suits standing beside a hole in lake ice, men in coats watching

scenes.narration: They went down at noon. The ropes kept feeding for forty minutes. In a lake thirty feet deep.
scenes.image: two ropes feeding down into round black water from coils on the ice, men in 1970s winter coats bracing them

scenes.narration: At one o'clock, one rope came back up. Empty. Cut clean.
scenes.image: close-up of a cleanly sliced rope end lying on snowy ice

scenes.narration: Ross Avery surfaced alone. He pulled off his mask, sat down on the ice, and never said another word. Not to the sheriff. Not to his wife. Not for the rest of his life.
scenes.image: 1970s diver sitting on the ice with his mask off, staring blankly ahead, frost in his hair, men standing around him

scenes.narration: The file has a photo of his notebook. One sentence, written over and over, until the pages ran out.
scenes.image: old spiral notebook lying open on a desk, pages densely covered in cramped repeated handwriting too small to read

scenes.narration: It isn't water down there. It's looking up.
scenes.image: view from deep underwater looking up at a perfectly round bright opening in thick ice, light pouring down

scenes.narration: Ross's address is in the file. The same road as Wade's cabin.
scenes.image: lonely snowy rural road through pine trees at dusk, a single cabin with a lit window

scenes.narration: When Wade gets home, there are wet footprints on his porch. Heavy diver's boots. Leading from the lake to his door.
scenes.image: wooden cabin porch at night, a trail of wet heavy boot prints coming up the steps to the front door, frozen lake behind
